name: Web Solution Smart Contact Button
author: websolutionnetwork

sections.description:
Web Solution Smart Contact Button adds a stylish floating contact widget to your WordPress site,
allowing visitors to reach you instantly

Features
– Floating button with animated bubbles
– Phone, Email, and chat app integration (e.g. WhatsApp, Viber)
– Gradient, Minimal, or Glass button styles
– Smooth pulse and color animations
– Live admin preview (identical to front-end)
– Responsive design for all devices
– Lightweight and fast loading

Perfect for
Freelancers, small businesses, and agencies who want an elegant contact shortcut on their website.

Credits

Developed by Web Solution Network
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/web-solution-smart-contact-button/,
    or install it directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Web Solution Smart Contact Button.
  4. Enable and configure your contact channels.
  5. Save changes — the floating button will appear on your site.
sections.faq:
Does it slow down my website?

No — it’s lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I customize the colors and animations?

Yes, you can set your own primary and secondary colors, and choose between multiple animation effects.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. It works perfectly on both mobile and desktop devices.

Can I disable some channels?

Yes, you can enable or disable Phone, Email, or chat options individually.
